learning_outcomes.text: The student will acquire fundamental concepts related to operating principles, theoretical-numerical analysis techniques, and the description of main microwave components in cable, waveguide, and microstrip. Experimental and numerical knowledge connected to the analysis and characterization of main microwave components, as well as the detection of electromagnetic field levels in the environment, will be acquired.

The student must demonstrate knowledge of the operating principles, theoretical-numerical analysis techniques, and description of main microwave components. They must also know the basics of microwave characterization.
The student must demonstrate the ability to apply the methodological tools acquired during the course, with particular reference to the analysis and characterization of microwave devices.

syllabus_topics: Microwave components: definition and description using impedance, admittance, and scattering matrices. Relative properties.

Main passive microwave components in waveguide, cable, and microstrip: attenuators, couplers, isolators, circulators, power dividers, phase shifters, terminations. Operating principles and methods for their theoretical and numerical analysis.
Representation of a microwave circuit using graphs and manipulation rules. Applications.
Introduction to solid-state microwave devices and monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) technology.
Experimental characterization of microwave components using traditional waveguide or cable circuits.
Vector and scalar network analyzer: operating principle, calibration, and brief notes on their practical use in modern experimental characterization of microwave components.
Regulations on protection from exposure to electromagnetic fields. Radiation monitor and spectrum analyzer: operating principle and their practical use in detecting field levels in the environment.
Use of electromagnetic CAD for the analysis of microwave components in waveguide, cable, and microstrip, and the design of simpler structures.

assessment_methods.method: Discussion of laboratory experience reports submitted at the end of the course

assessment_rules: The exam consists of a discussion of project work. The evaluation is based on the discussion of the laboratory experience reports submitted at the end of the course.
